items.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
items.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
items.description: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

items.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
items.description: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

items.title: New York building collapse kills one person and injures 12
items.description: Rescuers are searching for people who may be trapped under the rubble of the three-story building in Brooklyn.

items.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
items.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

items.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
items.description: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

items.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

items.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
items.description: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

items.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
items.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

items.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
items.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

items.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
items.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

items.title: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated
items.description: Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has also vehemently denied the allegation made in a US magazine.

items.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
items.description: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

items.title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
items.description: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

items.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
items.description: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.

items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
items.description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

items.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
items.description: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

items.title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike
items.description: Real Madrid player Vinícius Jr sent a surprise message to 13-year-old fan Zaher who lost both his legs after being hit by a drone in Khartoum, in 2024.

items.title: Watch: E-bike battery explodes into massive fireball inside Oregon home
items.description: Surveillance footage from inside the home shows a mother and son noticing smoke coming from the battery before it suddenly bursts into flames.
